descriptions.normal: A crunchy appetizer that's baked with mushrooms and cheese on top of bread slices. A single whiff of its amazing smell is enough to fill one with anticipation. Give it a bite, and you'll experience a pleasant burst of sweetness.
descriptions.suspicious: A crunchy delicacy. From the sorry side of the dish, it is easy to tell that this dish has been left out here for some time — water loss has already dried up and hardened the bread slices. Biting into it makes your chin sore... Next time, do remember to eat it while it's still nice and fresh...
descriptions.delicious: A crunchy delicacy. The faint creamy notes melt on your tongue as you munch on the succulent mushrooms and crispy bread. This unmatched sense of satisfaction somehow leaves you insatiable — you do not even hesitate to lick the bread crumbs off your fingertips.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1250 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 30% of Max HP and an additional 600 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 34% of Max HP and an additional 1900 HP to the selected character.
